No test pins the position of the 'could not be displayed' block in a multi-component stream.
CSV warning combination of display cut plus formula-protection warning is untested.
Uncut-table test only asserts the last line has no underscore.
Stale fallback comment and log message in _build_table_payload (corroborates F-1).
Internal doc omits the '(Results truncated to 1000 characters for preview.)' suffix from the run_sql tool-result description; capped at Suggestion as behavior-inert internal prose.

## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (no finding at or above the critical threshold; eight Suggestions remain)

The PR is ready to merge: all 52 checklist items passed, including all 16 acceptance criteria, and the reviewers raised only Suggestions.
Rule applied: rule 6 — only findings below the threshold remain → APPROVE with notes

## Code Review Findings

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (7)

<details><summary>7 items</summary>

1. The comment and the WARNING text around the table-payload build failure in `src/sqllens/tools/_format.py` (lines 829-846) are out of date. They still say the failure leaves "no widget" and serves "Markdown only". Since this change, the same failure also emits a "could not be displayed" text block that reaches the widget. (raised by 2/6 agents)
2. In `src/sqllens/agent/markers.py` (lines 447-464), `row_cap_marker_data` stores `int(cap)` without checking it, but `row_cap_of` accepts only a positive int that is not a bool. A cap of 0, for example when `MAX_ROWS_ATTR` is missing, would be written and then quietly ignored. No current producer reaches this case. (raised by 1/6 agents)
3. In `src/sqllens/_table_payload.py` (lines 300-343), the table payload is an untyped dict. Its invariants (`row_count + truncated`, and `row_cap` either absent or positive) are kept only by convention. Its underscore-private helpers are also used as the interface for other modules. (raised by 1/6 agents)
4. In `tests/unit/test_format.py` (lines 2106-2134), no test checks where the "could not be displayed" block sits in a stream with more than one component. (raised by 1/6 agents)
5. In `tests/unit/test_widget_cut_notice.py`, no test covers the CSV warning shown when a display-limit cut and the formula-protection warning apply together. (raised by 1/6 agents)
6. In `tests/unit/test_format.py` (lines 2090-2096), the uncut-table test only checks that the last line contains no underscore. That check would pass even if a note were added somewhere else. (raised by 1/6 agents)
7. `docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md` describes the agent's `run_sql` tool result as a CSV preview of at most 1,000 characters. That description leaves out the "(Results truncated to 1000 characters for preview.)" suffix that a cut preview gets. (raised by 1/6 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=held; evidence: internal doc page under docs/internal, which no tool reads and nothing publishes; making the sentence true changes no output -->

</details>
